subject: Renewal path: Contract workflow platform (Ironclad) + e-sign separation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: FYI: Ironclad renewal packet + initial negotiation asks

Evelyn / Karthik — attaching the Ironclad renewal quote we received last week. Key points: 12-month renewal, list price + 5% uplift over current, optional advanced KMS integration add-on (quoted separately).

Quick summary of recommended negotiation levers: 
- Ask for a multi-year discount or at least a 12% renewal credit tied to consolidated CLM+eSign billing.
- Push for committed SLA credits (target: 99.9% uptime with credits starting at 0.5% per hour).
- Request SOC2 Type II evidence and encryption/KMS integration details before signing.
- Separate e-sign provider (DocuSign) scope: evaluate decoupling to avoid vendor lock for signatures.

Please confirm whether Legal should prepare a redline (I can loop Markus) and if Finance is okay with the one-time KMS budget ask.

Attachments: Ironclad_Renewal_Quote_2027.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa
Procurement | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Green <alex.green@ironcladapp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal packet + pricing options for Redwood Inference

Hi Evelyn — great to catch up last month. Attached is the formal renewal quote for your account. We want to keep Redwood on the most current platform and can offer a 10% one-year renewal discount if you sign by April 15. KMS integration is supported; I included a high-level add-on cost in the quote.

Highlights:
- Standard 12-month renewal, enterprise plan (includes workflow automation, API access, audit logs)
- 10% time-limited discount if executed by 2027-04-15
- KMS/HSM integration: supported via our partner flow; implementation estimate 6-8 weeks
- SLA: 99.95% (enterprise) — credits are in our standard SOW, can be negotiated for a custom credit schedule

If Legal would like a copy of the latest T&Cs to redline, I can send it now. Happy to schedule a call with our security engineer to walk through the KMS details.

Best,
Alex Green
Enterprise Sales, Ironclad
Attachments: Ironclad_Renewal_Quote_2027.pdf
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@ironcladapp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:39:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal packet + pricing options for Redwood Inference

Alex — thanks, received and reviewed. A few asks from our side before we move to signature: 
1) Please send the latest T&Cs and an editable contract for redline. Markus will lead legal review.
2) Share SOC2 Type II report or a summary attestation and any penetration-test artifacts you can share under NDA.
3) We need a clear KMS integration architecture diagram and confirmation of key rotation/zero-knowledge handling.
4) We are exploring decoupling e-sign from the CLM: will the platform continue to function with an alternate e-sign provider if we keep Ironclad for workflow only? Please confirm.

If the 10% sign-by discount is firm, we will evaluate the schedule and budget in procurement. Can you hold that window while Legal completes redlines?

Thanks — I will coordinate a short review meeting.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Platform Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal packet + pricing options for Redwood Inference

Evelyn — looping in my notes after a quick pass. I requested the editable contract from Alex. Attached is a preliminary redline with our standard language. Key negotiation items we should push on: 
- Data residency clause: require EU/US residency options and customer control over retention policies.
- Audit rights: include right to audit or agent access to logs for compliance reviews.
- SLA credits: move to a more prescriptive credit schedule (we should ask for a 3x credit multiplier for platform downtime exceeding 1 hour in a month).
- KMS language: require explicit details on key custody, ability to rotate keys, and a contractual commitment that vendor cannot access customer plaintext.
- Termination for convenience / transition support: ensure export/hand-off obligations in plain machine-readable format.

I attached the redline (Ironclad_Contract_Redline_2027.docx). If Procurement can get a commercial counter (discount + timeline) I will prioritize a second pass.

-Markus
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Ironclad_Contract_Redline_2027.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>; Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Approval to proceed to commercial negotiation (conditional)

Team — after reviewing the quote and Markus's redline, Finance is comfortable authorizing Procurement to accept Ironclad's one-year renewal if the following conditions are met: 
- 10% sign-by discount is honored (Alex has indicated that window).
- KMS integration design and SOC2 docs are delivered to Security within 10 business days.
- SLA credit schedule acceptable to Legal (Markus will confirm final language).
- Ironclad agrees to a 60-day transitional support clause and export assurances in the SOW.

Procurement: please confirm you will request an updated quote with the redline/comments and a binding sign-by date. Also proceed to separately engage DocuSign to update our signature-only pricing; we want to keep flexibility on the e-sign provider.

Next steps: 
- Marissa: request binding commercial with Alex and get DocuSign pricing parallel.
- Markus: finalize redline and send to Alex for comment.
- Naomi: log the renewal in the vendor tracker and set reminder for 30/15/7 day escalation.

Karthik
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference
